title: Fill the gap between WoW Forever beta and launch: Guild of Souls, an RPG where you play your whole guild (Claude Code + Codex)
author: Mojo2013
selftext:
Guild of Souls is out on Steam. It's inspired by multiboxing: every hero you make joins your guild, you swap between them mid-fight, and you can take 40 of them into a raid. 40 classes, 11 dungeons, solo or co-op. Your healer can't flame you, because you are the healer.



WoW Forever beta's over and launch is next week, so here's something to raid in the gap.



Project started in Cursor 6 months ago with a Unity asset pack. I quickly realized it was out of Cursors depth (and mine). Started working on Guild of Souls again when Astra and Opus 5.5 dropped. Made with Claude Code and Codex in Unity 6. 



Steam (10% off for launch): [Guild of Souls](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5338720/Guild_of_Souls/)



I've been working all day and all night on the launch and hot fixes, so I'm off to bed. Ask me anything and I'll answer when I wake up.

comments.author: Mojo2013
comments.body: ChatGPT have been pumping out free resets and also 65k credits for rug pulling us -- I am on the $200 plan. Guild of Souls and a "few" other games are the result. Also max plan with Claude -- both have their strengths. Art like icons and such ChatGPT is very valuable. But for optimisation and code Claude saves the day -- they both are strong in different areas
